situationTips.emergency: In a life-threatening emergency call 119; for hospital guidance try 1339.
situationTips.car: On expressways, call the public tow service first.
situationTips.crime: If it's voice phishing, hang up and call 1398.

situationTips.abroad: Overseas, the consular call center can help in Korean.
situationTips.legal: Before a lawsuit, try free legal advice at 132.
